_mode_comment: store: own cart and checkout. affiliate: outbound links to merchants, no cart. Override per build with SHOPPI_MODE.

catalog._comment: local reads src/_data/catalog/*.json. shopify reads the Storefront API at build time (SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN, SHOPIFY_STOREFRONT_TOKEN). api reads any JSON API. custom loads your own adapter module. feed reads a network CSV/JSON product feed (docs/affiliate.md).

api._comment: Generic JSON API. ${VAR} is replaced from the environment, so tokens stay out of this file. Field names may be nested, e.g. "price.amount".

affiliate.disclosure: Needs your input: write your affiliate disclosure here. Links on this site may earn us a commission at no extra cost to you. If you use Amazon Associates, include the exact statement their agreement requires.

checkout._comment: preview | shopify | stripe-link | endpoint. See docs/checkout.md.

shipping.note: Shipping and taxes are calculated at checkout.

policies.shipping: Needs your input: describe delivery times and rates here. The chat quotes this text word for word.
policies.returns: Needs your input: describe your return window and process here. The chat quotes this text word for word.

chat.name: Store assistant
chat.greeting: Hi! I can help you find products, check your cart or answer questions about the store.
